title: Delivery Frequency of Tailwise Autoship Pharmacy Subscriptions under the Linked Prescription
content:
**Pharmacy care desk — weeks between prescription Autoship shipments**

This rule sets the weeks between shipments of an Autoship Pharmacy or Autoship Compounded Pharmacy subscription under Tailwise Autoship, written as the subscription's frequency in weeks, whenever the subscription is re-timed under its linked prescription.

Once a renewed prescription has been linked to a pharmacy Autoship, the subscription is due to be re-timed under the renewed prescription, whether or not the customer raises it.

The weeks between shipments of a pharmacy Autoship are re-timed only after its package count per shipment has been re-set under the prescription it is linked to.

Put the other way round: a frequency for a pharmacy Autoship is not re-timed while its package count per shipment has yet to be re-set under the linked prescription. Re-timing is a change to an existing subscription and sits within the Tailwise Autoship change rules for that subscription.

## Effect of re-timing

The subscription's frequency becomes the number of weeks set, and every shipment after the upcoming one is scheduled that many weeks after the previous one. The packages per shipment, the item, the linked prescription and the already scheduled next ship date stay unchanged. The customer sees the new frequency on the subscription right away.

## Recording the frequency: `set_rx_shipment_interval_b175142c`

**Capability.** Sets the delivery frequency, in weeks between shipments, of one existing prescription Autoship (Autoship Pharmacy or Autoship Compounded Pharmacy). The care agent performs it.

**How it is invoked.** The agent unlocks the tool with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, then calls `set_rx_shipment_interval_b175142c` through `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

- `autoship_id` — the reference number of the prescription Autoship subscription whose frequency is set, as the customer's Autoship subscriptions lookup shows it (Id).
- `frequency_weeks` — the number of weeks between shipments from now on; an integer number of whole weeks, no decimals.

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with three fields: `autoship_id` (the subscription reference number that was updated), `frequency_weeks` (the weeks between shipments now on the subscription) and `status`, always `updated` when the change was saved. A status of `updated` is the success receipt.
